sections.title: 1. General Provisions and Terms
paras: This Privacy Policy (the ‘Policy’) governs the personal data processing relationship between SP Shagidov F.T., TIN 22102197700907, address: Bishkek, Usenbaeva St. 138a (the ‘Company’) and a user of the websites vokalo.kg; vokalo.ru; vokalo.online (the ‘User’).
‘User’ means a legally capable individual aged 18+ wishing to order services, leave a comment, register on the website, or perform other actions enabled by the Company’s web resources.
‘Website’ means the Company’s websites vokalo.kg; vokalo.ru; vokalo.online, including all domain levels.
‘Personal data’ means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.

‘Processing of personal data’ means any operation or set of operations performed with or without automation: collection, receipt, recording, systematization, accumulation, storage, updating, extraction, use, transfer (disclosure, provision, access), anonymization, blocking, deletion, destruction.

sections.title: 2. Scope and Principles
paras: This Policy defines the procedure, conditions and principles of processing, Users’ rights, the Company’s obligations, and implemented protection measures.
The Policy applies to all personal data the Company receives from Users.

sections.title: 3. User Consent
paras: The User accepts the Policy by entering their name, phone number and, if required, e‑mail into a Website form and clicking ‘Submit’, ‘Request a consultation’, etc.
If the User disagrees, they must immediately stop using the Website.

sections.title: 4. Personal Data Provided by the User
paras: Depending on the functionality used: surname, name, e‑mail address, phone number, user identification data (user ID).

sections.title: 5. Legal Basis and Term of Processing
paras: By providing data, the User consents to processing (until withdrawal), including collection, storage, anonymization, transfer to third parties in cases provided by the Policy, for advertising, information, services provision and other purposes under Section 8.
The Company follows KR Law No. 58 of 14.04.2008 ‘On Personal Information’, EU GDPR of 27.04.2016, other KR legislation and local acts.
Consent is effective from provision until purposes are achieved or until withdrawn by the User. The User may withdraw consent as set out in this Policy.

sections.title: 6. Data Clarification and Withdrawal
paras: To clarify incomplete/inaccurate/outdated data or to withdraw consent, the User sends an official request to {{email}} with the subject ‘Clarify personal data’ or ‘Stop processing personal data’, indicating their e‑mail and request.

sections.title: 7. Purposes of Processing
paras: 8.1 user registration and identification;
8.2 communication on the User’s request, including with partners; consulting;
8.3 creating an account and providing access (including on partner sites);
8.4 sending informational messages;
8.5 advertising/promotion, content personalization;
8.6 assessing and analyzing the Website;
8.7 advertising effectiveness analytics and statistical research based on anonymized data;
8.8 informing about promotions, discounts and special offers (email, phone);
8.9 marketing research (including via contractors);
8.10 communication with partner banks regarding lending.

sections.title: 8. Company Assumptions About User Data
paras: The Company does not verify data and assumes the User is legally capable; provides accurate and up‑to‑date data; understands that information they post may be accessible and, in cases under the Policy, copied or shared by others.

sections.title: 9. Processing Principles
paras: Lawfulness; limitation by purposes; no incompatible processing; appropriateness of data content/scope; no excessive processing; accuracy, sufficiency and relevance; destruction or anonymization upon achieving purposes, loss of need, receipt of a destruction request or withdrawal of consent.

sections.title: 10. Protection Measures and Processing Conditions
paras: The Company implements organizational and technical protection measures.
Processing uses databases within the Kyrgyz Republic.
Processing may be automated or manual.
Transfer to third parties occurs only as provided by the Policy; to partners — based on the User’s consent for performance of obligations.
Partners must keep data confidential and not disclose without the User’s consent unless required by law/Policy.
Storage on electronic media and, if needed, on physical media.
Storage until: deletion by the User; destruction upon request/withdrawal; consent expiry.
Anonymized storage may continue after obligations are fulfilled for the purposes in 8.7.

sections.title: 11. Transfers to Partners
paras: Partners ensure confidentiality and non‑disclosure;
Partners implement security measures (protection tools; detection and response to unauthorized access; access limitation; control of measures effectiveness);
Partners are prohibited from further transfer/dissemination of Users’ personal data.

sections.title: 12. Lawful Disclosure and Anonymized Sharing
paras: Not a violation: disclosure under applicable KR law; provision to partners under contract to fulfill obligations; anonymized sharing for assessing/analyzing the Website, providing recommendations, showing ads, marketing/analytics/statistics.

sections.title: 13. Cookies and Analytics
paras: The Company may use cookies — data (including IP, geolocation, browser/OS info, device technical characteristics, access date/time) automatically transmitted while using the Website.
Cookies are used to remember settings and collect analytics. Using the Website signifies consent to cookies/analytics and to their transfer to third parties.

sections.title: 14. IP Address and Referrer
paras: The Company obtains the User’s IP address and referrer. This is not used to identify the visitor.

sections.title: 15. User Rights and Timelines
paras: The Company provides the User/representative free access to the User’s personal data.
If incompleteness/inaccuracy/outdated data is found, the Company updates within 7 business days and notifies the User.
If unlawful obtaining/processing or mismatch with purposes is confirmed, the Company destroys such data within 7 business days and notifies the User.

sections.title: 16. Cessation and Destruction
paras: The Company ceases processing or ensures partner cessation if processing is unlawful; consent is withdrawn; a destruction request is received; the purpose is achieved.
Destruction within 30 days unless otherwise required by law; if impossible — blocking with subsequent destruction within the statutory period, no more than 6 months.

sections.title: 17. Partners
paras: The Company determines the list of partners and publishes it via available means, including on the Website.

sections.title: 18. Policy Changes
paras: The Company may amend the Policy at any time. The current text is published on the Website.

sections.title: 19. Acceptance of New Version
paras: Continued use after publication of an updated Policy constitutes acceptance. If the User disagrees, they must stop using the Website and services.
